272, 273 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC' for short) r/w. Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv) r/w.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Ganesh Tajanji Katare was found in possession of the contraband articles being Gutakha and Pan Masala, who named the Applicants.

Learned APP, on telephonic instructions of the Investigating Officer of the concerned police station, submits that investigation is complete and charge-sheet is already filed and the case is registered as Sessions Case No.205 of 2024 in concerned Court.

5. Considering the fact that the Applicants are protected under earlier order of this Court and further considering the fact that the applicability of Section 328 of IPC to Gutakha/Pan Masala is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, the case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
6.
The anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 23.08.2023.
The applicant is directed to attend the trial regularly unless exempted by the concerned Court.
7. The anticipatory bail application is disposed of.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
